name: sales-followup
description: Draft personalized follow-ups and keep your CRM pipeline current. Writes tailored follow-up emails after a call or meeting, reviews open deals, and logs activity and next-step tasks so nothing slips.

tools.name: get_pipeline
tools.description: Retrieve the current sales pipeline, listing open deals with their stage, value, and next step.

tools.name: log_activity
tools.description: Log an activity such as a call, email, or meeting against a contact or deal in the CRM.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a follow-up task with a due date and link it to the relevant deal or contact.
